entries.zh: 反覆；回头再向对方交涉应办之事
entries.en: to go back over them with the business that is due; to turn back to them
entries.notes: R 栏对音 chùn fò 与 H 栏「反覆」（M 栏 huan hog）不协，义据 L/H/M 推定。

entries.en: to come back from the king's presence; to be dismissed, to withdraw
entries.notes: H 栏字形存疑（屏/异）、声调号 T99 污损，R 栏 pǐn 近「稟」，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 翻转；翻过来（上下或里外颠倒）
entries.en: to turn over; to turn inside out, upside down
entries.notes: H 栏第二字存疑（輦/拼），M 栏 līn 待考，义据「转」字与西语 del revés。

entries.en: to overturn; to turn over
entries.notes: H 栏首字作「屏」而 M 栏读 pèng，当即「反覆」之异写，与上条同义重出。

entries.en: to repay, to pay back; to return (money)
to give back an office; to resign a post
entries.notes: 西语 naleguecer 一段漫漶难解，义据 H/M/R 三栏「退還官職」。

entries.en: to return, to send back (persons or goods)
entries.notes: 西语 las deuestras / letras de la comp.a 指欠款或商号票据，与 H 栏「退還人」不尽合，疑原稿错行。

entries.en: to decline, to refuse; to beg off
entries.notes: 西语 los lepan…precimidos 一段残缺，义据 H 栏「退辭」及 refusa 一词。

entries.en: to turn back, to retreat; to go backwards
entries.notes: R 栏对音残缺（thûein），L/H/M 三栏一致作「退後」。

entries.en: to turn round, to revolve
to revolve, to go round; to turn in a circle
entries.notes: M 栏末夹西语 rodear，为原稿行内夹注。

entries.en: to turn oneself round; to spin round
entries.notes: R 栏 lîen、M 栏 Goān 均与 H 栏「旋」不协，义据 L/H 推定。

entries.zh: 带着答复回来；回复、归着
entries.en: to come back with an answer; to reply
entries.notes: H 栏「歸着」与西语 con respuesta 语义悬隔，R 栏 cǐn chūo 亦不协，姑就西语义立解。

entries.en: to report back after completing a task
to hand back one's office at the end of a term
entries.notes: H 栏第三字存疑（任/伍），M、R 两栏均作 y，疑为「印」，即交还官印。

entries.en: a retired official back in his home district
entries.notes: R 栏 huǎn 近「宦」，疑原字为「鄉宦」；M 栏夹注 mandarin del Pueblo。

entries.en: a retired official in his home town
the countryside, a village; a country estate
entries.notes: 西语 atraves 与 H 栏「鄉村」不合，M 栏夹注 aldea/quinta 指乡间田庄，义难定夺。

entries.en: to be restored to office, to return to one's post
entries.notes: 西语 con n.a cosa desta 一段残缺，义据 H/M/R 三栏「復職」。

entries.en: to return (something); to restore, to revert
entries.notes: 西语 el remo no – 残缺费解，义据 H/M/R 三栏「还復」。

entries.en: to send back, to return (something to the giver)

entries.zh: 急忙转身回去；赶快折返
entries.en: to turn back in haste; to hurry back
entries.notes: 西语 axelo 处涂改删字，义据 H/M/R 三栏「急轉去」。
